potoru.description: Namespace: version, get(id) (players and snapshots), getEditor(id), mountPotoPlayer, mountPotoSnapshot, mountPotoEditor, compile, loadPlayer.

mountPotoPlayer.description: Mount a Potoru player into a host element (loads the player code on demand); resolves to the instance.

mountPotoSnapshot.description: Draw one still frame of a story into a host element (loads the light snapshot code on demand); resolves to the instance.

mountPotoEditor.description: Mount the editor (YAML / Script toggle, files, diagnostics, preview) into a host element (loads the compiler code on demand).

compile.description: Compile YAML ({ yaml }: a source folder as path → text) or a Script ({ script }: authoring-API JavaScript, experimental) to .poto bytes with diagnostics.

PotoPlayer.description: TSX wrapper: server-rendered placeholder the runtime mounts a <potoru-player> into (still + time shows one frame).

PotoSnapshot.description: TSX wrapper: server-rendered placeholder the runtime draws one still frame into (no controls, no sound, no engines).

PotoEditor.description: TSX wrapper: server-rendered placeholder for the editor (YAML / Script, files, diagnostics, live preview).
